sourceSignals.claim: The current docs define an execution DAG but do not fully specify the ingestion boundary from live grant work into that DAG.
sourceSignals.evidence: Execution DAG nodes and edges exist, but adapter/event ingestion is not first-class.

sourceSignals.claim: Existing strategy evidence names Reflection Packet, memory query, outcome weighting, CycleReceipt, and adapter-shaped surfaces.
sourceSignals.evidence: The strategy brief maps cross-cycle learning, memory query, Brain/JIT primitives, and first-90-day focus areas.

sourceSignals.claim: GoldenQuill already has adapter discipline in Scout and similar boundaries should be generalized for grant-work events.
sourceSignals.evidence: Scout channel and portal adapters use producer-specific ids and caps; this supports explicit adapter contracts.

sourceSignals.claim: Accumulated knowledge should return to grant work only after governance, privacy, and owner decision.
sourceSignals.evidence: Current workflow already separates candidate, governance projection, redaction/generalization, and owner decision.

sourceSignals.claim: Outcome measurement must cover lifecycle, quality, strategy, cost, ROI, relationship, stewardship, and learning quality.
sourceSignals.evidence: The existing KPI catalog already includes these families but does not yet connect them to event/projector components.

sourceSignals.claim: The work should split into self-contained projects so event spine, adapters, metrics, knowledge feedback, governance, and UX can validate independently.
sourceSignals.evidence: The current first slice is fixture-only but bundles several concerns into one validator.

sourceSignals.claim: The event-spine patch proposal introduces new concepts, operations, mappings, workflows, metrics, and fixtures that must be reflected in TOC and index surfaces.
sourceSignals.evidence: Patch Set J defines the required TOC and index updates.

deltaSummary.note: Architecture ingestion boundary and TOC/index surfaces need proposal alignment.
